Scope of Work 1. Introduction Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management ( ABV-IIITM), Gwalior, invites bids for the supply, installation, commissioning, and w arranty of 200 All-in-One (AIO) Desktop Computers. The selected vendor (Bidder/ OEM) shall be responsible for delivering a fully functional, configured, and ready-t o-use system at the designated location, along with onsite warranty and mainten ance services for hardware and software-related problems. 2. Scope of Work for Supply 2.1. The bidder/OEM shall furnish All-in-One (AIO) Desktop Computers and associated accessories (e.g., keyboard, mouse, power cords) as specified in accordance with the Schedule of Requirements provided in Annexure-A and the Technical Specific ations detailed in Annexure-B. 2.2. All equipment supplied must be brand new, fully functional, and operable, confor ming to the specifications and requirements of this tender. No refurbished or end -of-life products will be accepted. 2.3. The bidder/OEM shall be responsible for the supply, delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, and basic user handover of all systems at the locations specified by ABV-IIITM Gwalior. 2.4 The work shall be executed on a turnkey basis, which means that all components , accessories, cables, and necessary items for making the desktops fully operatio nal shall be supplied and installed within the quoted price. 2.5 All items supplied under this tender — including AIO desktops and bundled access ories — shall carry an onsite OEM warranty for a period of three (3) years from the date of successful installation and acceptance by the institute. 2.6 During the warranty period, the vendor shall provide maintenance services for an y hardware and software-related problems, ensuring minimum downtime and pro mpt resolution. Support must include hardware repairs/replacement and software- level assistance for pre-installed OS and basic utilities. 2.7 The vendor must ensure that all required components are integrated and configu red correctly. This includes but is not limited to BIOS setup, operating system acti vation, driver installation, and network configuration as required. 2.8 The vendor shall provide relevant documents including OEM warranty certificate, OS license details, installation checklist, and equipment serial number list at the ti me of delivery and acceptance.

3. Scope of Work for Installation and Commissioning 3.1. The bidder/OEM shall carry out installation and commissioning of the supplied sy stems at the designated site within the specified time frame. 3.2. The bidder/OEM shall maintain cleanliness of the site and ensure removal of all p ackaging and installation waste from the work site. 3.3. All required tools and materials for installation shall be arranged by the bidder/O EM at their own cost. 3.4 Any damage caused to the property of Tenderer while executing the job shall be solely Bidder/OEM/Vendor's responsibility. In case any damage to the property is caused, the same will be recovered from the Bidder/OEM/Vendors. No extra cost shall be paid to the Bidder/OEM/Vendor for such reasons. 3.5 Bidder/ OEM shall install and configure all the necessary software including sy stems software (e.g. OS, drivers, etc). 3.6 All systems shall be tested for functional verification in the presence of institu te representatives. 3.7 The following minimum equipment is to be installed as per the Technical Spe cifications prescribed in this bid document. Further on rectification of all the discrepancies iden tified during the SAT, TENDERER/ABV-IIITM representatives will re-conduct the SAT or if agreed SAT will be signed. 4.3 The warranty and OEM support shall commence only after the installation and formal acceptance by the department. 4.4 During the warranty period, the bidder shall maintain the systems and repair or replace all defective components at the installation site, free of cost. All def ective components that are brought to the bidder notice.

4.5 As far as possible, the bidder shall attempt to repair/replace the defective equip ment onsite. 4.6 The bidder shall ensure that the warranty services comply with the technical stan dards, security requirements, operating procedures, and recovery procedures agr eed upon. 5. Selection Criteria of OEM 5.1 The OEM of the All-in-One Desktop Computer must have service centers in G walior, Madhya Pradesh. 5.2 All products quoted must be listed on the global website of the respective OE M. 5.3 The bid must include a Manufacturer Authorization Form or a Registered/Auth orized Partner Certificate from the OEM of the All-in-One Desktop Computers. 5.4 Point No. 5.1 to 5.3 shall be certified by the OEM/Bidder through their registe red office in India and/or should be verifiable through OEM’s website. 6. Maintenance of Services 6.1 The bidder shall ensure repairing / replacement of all faulty material within the sh ortest possible time thus ensuring minimum downtime, failing which applicable p enalty may be imposed. 6.2 If any equipment gives continuous trouble, (e.g., three failures in a single month), the bidder shall replace the hardware at no additional cost to the purchaser. 7. Related Information 7.1 The bidder must ensure necessary safety precautions are taken while carrying o ut installation within the labs to avoid any unforeseen event. 7.2 All the systems and software supplied along with the AIO Desktops shall become the property of buyer. 7.3 The successful bidder/contractor shall give on-site warranty for AIO Desktop Com puter and Software supplied under this contract. 8. Instructions to bidders 8.1 The supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of the systems must be completed within 45 days from the date of the confirmed purchase order. Bid

ders must confirm acceptance of this schedule in the Technical Bid. 8.2 Bidder must ensure that the warranty support & service should be available u p to delivery locations to provide repairing cum replacement services of faulty equipment’s within 48 hrs. Bidder is required to provide the escalation matrix and name & address & contact details of the concerned firm/person for providi ng warranty support & repairing cum replacement service up to delivery locati ons. 8.3 If any equipment gives continuous trouble, say more than 3 times in one mon th during the warranty period, the bidder shall replace the same with new equ ipment without any additional cost to the purchaser. 8.4 Free maintenance services shall be provided by the Bidder during the period of warranty. 8.5 If the bidder fails to provide satisfactory support or causes unwarranted delay s, ABV-IIITM reserves the right to repair the equipment at the risk and cost of t he bidder. 9. Penalty Clause 9.1 Penalties for delay in delivery and installation: If the bidder fails to deli ver and install the requisite devices or software within the time limit, then a s um equivalent to 0.5% of contract Value shall be deducted from the payment for each calendar week of delay or part thereof subject to a maximum limit of 5% of the total contract value. 9.1.1 Delay in excess of 6 weeks will be sufficient to cause for termination o f the contract. In that case the Performance Bank Guarantee of the bid der will be forfeited. 9.1.2 In case, the selected bidder does not supply the ordered items for any reason, he will be liable to pay the difference amount to the purchaser, over and above the Performance Guarantee. 9.1.3 In case, delay for delivery and installation of the requisite hardware an d software will be due to Purchasing Department OR its field offices, th en penalty will not be imposed. 9.2 Operational / Warranty period Penalties: 9.2.1 During warranty period, if the complaint is not resolved within 48 hrs t he penalty of: i) Rs. 100 per day for All in One Desktop Computer, ii) Rs. 200 per day f or other peripherals will be levied. However, if the complaints not resol ved within 7 days then from 8th day to 14th day, penalty would be levie d @ 150% and from 15th day onwards penalty @ 200% of the above ra tes would be levied. The amount of penalty will be recovered from the Performance bank guarantee during warranty period. 10. Arbitration 10.1 If a dispute of any kind whatsoever arises between the ABV-IIITM and the vendor in connection with, or arising out of, the Contract or the execution

of the works or after their completion and whether before or after the repu diation or other termination of the contract, including any disagreement b y either party with any action, in action, opinion, instruction, determinatio n, certificate or valuation of the Engineer, the matter in dispute shall be se ttled by arbitration in accordance with the Indian Arbitration and Conciliati on Act, 1996 or any statutory amendment thereof. 10.2 The reference to arbitration may proceed notwithstanding that the works shall not then be or be alleged to be completed, provide always that the o bligations of the ABV-IIITM, Gwalior and the Bidder shall not be altered by r eason of the arbitration being conducted during the progress of the works. Neither party shall be entitled to suspend the works, payments to the Bidd er shall be continued to be made as provided by the contract. 10.3 Arbitration proceedings shall be held at Gwalior and the language of the a rbitration proceedings and that of all documents and communications bet ween the parties shall be English. 10.4 All arbitration awards shall be in writing and shall state the reasons for th e award. 10.5 Penalty/Liquidate Damages shall not fall under the Arbitration clause. 11. Terms and Conditions for submission of Bids 11.1 The tender should be valid for a period of six Months (06 Months) from th e date of opening of the tender. 11.2 Bidders must be registered with sales/ Trade Tax department. The Bidder s are also required to provide their registration number along with the Bid s and proof. 11.3 Bidders must be registered with Income Tax department. The Bidders ha ve to provide their PAN number along with proof. 11.4 All the tenders/Bids must be accompanied by the receipt copy of required security (EMD) as mentioned in tender document in the form of NEFT/RTG S in favor of Director, ABV-IIITM Gwalior. 11.5 The competent authority of the Institute has every right to extend the du e date of tender if so required but all the Bids/tenders will be opened toge ther. 11.6 Deduction of T.D.S will be made as per Government rules.

11.7 Bids/Tenders deviating from above terms and Conditions will be rejected straight away without assigning any reason thereof. 11.8 All disputes are subject to the Jurisdiction of Gwalior court only. 11.9 The Institute has all rights to reject any or all quotations/Tenders without assigning any reason.
